answer_1.quote: We also evaluated the compressed models by observing the text they generated. In general, at 20% compression of Phi-2 3B, the generation ability and knowledge remained nearly intact.

answer_2.quote: Using lm-evaluation-harness, we evaluate the zero-shot performance of the base and compressed models on 9 downstream tasks: TruthfulQA (TruQA; al., 2022)), Social IQa (SIQA; (Sap et al., 2019)), LogiQA (Liu et al., 2020), WinoGrande (WinoG; (Sakaguchi et al., 2019)), Arc Easy (ARC-E; (Clark et al., 2018)), Arc Challenge (ARC-C; (Clark et al., 2018)), BoolQ (Clark et al., 2019), PIQA (Bisk et al., 2020), OpenBookQA (OBQA; )
